title: NSClient - translation issues
symptom: In NSClient 3.0.0.1, despite setting language to English in Preferences>General>Language, some UI elements (hamburger menu, home screen, local profile screen, three dot menu) are still translated to the default system language (Polish). Additionally, when the default system language differs from the preference language, an extra option for NSClient preferences -> synchronisation appears, which is absent when the languages match.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit referenced in the thread: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/8653c0f0d64a0f91d27e480a998c617b8dcaea0b
